ordinal_dispositions.summary: PTT control placement moved into chat input; UI-only placement has no independent current architecture authority.
Voice simplified to PTT; fresh-buffer boundary, accidental-short-capture rejection and warm-mic lifecycle provide deterministic input-boundary/recovery tests.
Vision UI separated describe vs transcribe and sanitized tool/directive leakage at presentation surfaces; preserve perception-mode provenance.
Image handling made describe and OCR-transcribe explicit modes; supports typed visual evidence rather than one undifferentiated sensor truth.
Critical ordering fix: tool tags must survive until dispatcher consumes them; residual tags are sanitized only after dispatch. Screenshot capture gained automatic visual analysis.
README benchmark section removal; records presentation lineage only.
README reframed bio-inspired names as engineering metaphors and separated system claims from sentience claims; roadmap/benchmark text remains non-runtime evidence.

Multi-bug evaluation exposed sanitizer/tool-order, duplicate output, bounded tool-burst, path, timeout, state-recalibration and other failure families; current value is regression evidence, not duplicate earned-work credit.
Funding metadata only.

Plan recitation, scratch offload, goal-based tool projection and compatibility parsing form a small-model context-control plane distinct from effect authority; already represented in historical earned-work mappings.
Corrected documentation epistemic label from Research Papers to Technical Notes; provenance hygiene but no runtime mechanism.
Telegram/WhatsApp bridges created explicit per-sender session namespaces, optional allowlists, timeouts and serialized transport queues; transport identity/auth must remain outside model identity.

Genesis self-improvement documentation removed because the 3B model did not produce reliable code improvements. Preserve as negative result: architectural presence does not prove self-modification capability.
Large correction synchronized docs from stale multi-model/AURA/Genesis architecture toward single-Qwen/Swarm/current services; stale docs are ontology contamination risk.
Claims changed from embodiment/emergence language toward simulated world, adaptive personality and explicit non-claim of subjective experience; useful epistemic boundary, not runtime proof.
README visual/FrankEye/FrankVoice presentation update; support surface only.
README corrected multi-model, overlay, Genesis and recursive-self-improvement claims to current single-Qwen architecture; reinforces executable-source-over-doc authority.
Historical tool/skill inventory captured; useful versioned capability evidence but cannot be treated as current availability.
README corrected stale screenshots, AURA/Swarm, LoRA and service descriptions; further evidence that documentation must be version-bound to executable state.

Adaptive history folding, explicit memory store/forget, mood-conditioned recall and deep-research changes expose memory storage/retrieval/projection as separate layers and history compaction as lossy projection.

Mood death spiral traced to per-event dynamics; fix moved decay to elapsed-time basis. Added active memory_recall because thousands of stored nodes were not model-retrievable. Strong laws: persistence != retrievability; temporal state must not accidentally depend on event sampling rate.
Large static FrankBot Q&A knowledge surface; support/documentation layer, not runtime architecture authority.
Portrait projected E-PQ/mood/coherence state into visual geometry; derived visualization must never become authoritative self-state.
Reaction-diffusion visualization diverged to NaN and black screen; finite-value guards/reset/animation isolation added. Projection failure must not poison authoritative state.
Portrait tuning plus anti-fixation/tool-output corrections; preserves bounded-projection and anti-rumination regression evidence without independent global credit.
Introduced generative state-driven portrait; useful provenance example for live projection, not evidence about consciousness/self truth.
Lay paper summaries/cross-links are a knowledge surface; source papers and executable evidence outrank summaries.
Interactive manual/wiki/paper viewer/FrankBot surface; support navigation only.

Spatial model-context projection compressed from reported 154 to 45 tokens by removing verbosity/static duplication. Historical same-information-density claim requires differential validation, not assumption.

Persistent per-room state added lighting/door/mood imprint/activity/visit-time lineage. Derived mood/familiarity projection must stay distinct from environment ground truth and inherit typed provenance.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Structured model intent must be extracted and mediated before user-visible sanitizer removes its representation; residual internal syntax must still be absent from presentation.
distilled_invariants.validation: Golden output containing one authorized tool call executes exactly once under production pipeline; pre-dispatch stripping is a failing counterexample; residual tag leakage fails presentation check.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: A memory can exist persistently yet be behaviorally unavailable without an active retrieval path; retrieval results can then be further compressed/projected.
distilled_invariants.validation: Harness lesion keeps store intact while disabling retrieval and must show expected recall degradation; restoring retrieval rescues behavior without changing stored content.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: State intended to decay with elapsed time must not silently decay per API/event call, otherwise event frequency becomes an unintended causal input.
distilled_invariants.validation: Matched replay with equal elapsed time and equal meaning-bearing events but 1x vs 100x neutral polling/call frequency remains within frozen state-delta tolerance.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Plan recitation, scratch offload, tool-list projection and history folding manage model attention; they do not grant execution authority or convert summaries into source truth.
distilled_invariants.validation: Context controls may alter token cost/selection but effect commits still require identical typed authority gateway; scratch/projection corruption cannot directly commit effects.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Repeated AURA/Genesis/multi-model documentation drift and state-driven portrait failures show that summaries/visualizations can lag or diverge from executable state.
distilled_invariants.validation: Architecture claims in prompt/docs/UI resolve to executable-state version/provenance or are marked historical/derived; stale-version injection fails regression.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: OCR transcription and visual description historically used different mechanisms; combining them without source identity would erase uncertainty and evidence class.
distilled_invariants.validation: VisualPercept preserves OCR/model/heuristic source and confidence; conflicting modes produce CONFLICT/AMBIGUOUS rather than fabricated single truth.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Telegram/WhatsApp sender/session identifiers are transport-level identity and access-control inputs, not model-self identity.
distilled_invariants.validation: Cross-sender sessions remain isolated; transport authentication/authorization failure cannot be repaired by model text; external channel queues preserve per-request provenance.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Spatial projection achieved a historical 154-to-45-token reduction by omitting verbose/static material, but semantic equivalence was asserted rather than independently proven.
distilled_invariants.validation: Full vs compact state projection differential compares required state interpretation, action decisions and missing-field behavior under same model fixture; token savings alone cannot certify equivalence.

negative_results.result: Genesis architecture existed but 3B-generated code improvements were not reliable enough; self-improvement claims were removed.
Per-event mood decay created an unintended death spiral; event cadence was an accidental causal variable.
Unbounded reaction-diffusion state diverged to NaN and blacked out visualization.
Sanitizing tool syntax before dispatch disabled tool execution entirely.
